name: agent-tmux-web
description: Mobile-friendly browser control panel for terminal agent CLIs running inside tmux.

scripts.android:build: pnpm build && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug assembleRelease
scripts.android:build:public: pnpm build && cd android && ./gradlew assembleRelease -PagentTmuxDefaultUrl= -PagentTmuxDefaultToken= -PagentTmuxApplicationIdSuffix= -PagentTmuxAppLabel="Agent Tmux" && cd .. && pnpm android:verify-public-apk
scripts.android:build:play: pnpm build && cd android && ./gradlew bundleRelease -PagentTmuxDefaultUrl= -PagentTmuxDefaultToken= -PagentTmuxApplicationIdSuffix= -PagentTmuxAppLabel="Agent Tmux" && cd .. && pnpm android:verify-public-apk android/app/build/outputs/bundle/release/app-release.aab
